subject.title: feat(auto-reply): add "commentary" verbose level for narration-only progress

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose narration-only progress as a fourth globally persisted verbose level, including suppression of tool-class operational notices and failure detail?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but it expands a long-lived public config and session contract and chooses a user-visible semantic boundary that source inspection cannot authorize.

options.title: Sponsor global preset
options.body: Accept `commentary` as the canonical cross-surface narration-only mode after a clean rebase and final exact-head review.

options.title: Keep channel controls
options.body: Decline the global persisted value and continue solving narration/tool separation through channel-specific streaming settings.

recommendation.title: Sponsor global preset
recommendation.body: Accept `commentary` as the canonical cross-surface narration-only mode after a clean rebase and final exact-head review.
